title: Last 3103.devA kills connection to DASH
symptom: The latest dev build killed things. For DASH, no more pod history (shows a blank page and then slows the AAPS UI). No more beep the pod, nor connect to pod. Also, pod is connected but basal cannot be set, and no bolus delivery possible.
cause: The thread suggests a database update is not handled properly, possibly related to PR #1999, but the exact root cause is not confirmed.
fix: Reinstalling the older devA gets back the pod connection but loses selected profile, BG history etc. PR #1999 was removed. The issue seems to resolve itself after some time.
evidence_quote: it seems db update is not handled properly ..... i'll check on my phone
